title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
code: age_check(   x,   no_overlap = NA,   no_gap = NA,   no_total = NA,   no_na = NA,   include_zero = NA,   include_open = NA,   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )  age_assert(   x,   no_overlap = NA,   no_gap = NA,   no_total = NA,   no_na = NA,   include_zero = NA,   include_open = NA,   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )

title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
text: x Vector age group labels. no_overlap age groups overlap no_gap age groups span entire range lower limit youngest age group upper limit oldest age group no_total "Total" age group no_na NA age group include_zero One age groups lower limit zero. include_open One age groups upper limit. unknown_label Action meaning label unclear. Choices "error" (default), "warn", "silent".

title: Check or Make Assertions About Age Groups — age_check
text: age_check() returns list components ok (logical flag) details (data frame). age_assert() returns x invisibly, throws error.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
text: Lower upper limits can used filter age. See examples. age_mid() uses formula age_lower(x) + 0.5 * age_width(x), except open age groups, "100+", uses age_lower(x) + 0.5 * median_width median_width median closed intervals.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths and Midpoints of Age Groups — age_lower
code: x <- c("5-9", "10-14", "100+") age_lower(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>     5    10   100  age_upper(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>    10    15   Inf  age_width(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>     5     5   Inf  age_mid(x) #>   5-9 10-14  100+  #>   7.5  12.5 102.5   ## use 'age_lower()' to filter on age library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(   ~age, ~count,                 "5-9",     11,               "10-14",     20,                "100+",      7 )        df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 5-9      11 #> 2 10-14    20 #> 3 100+      7 df |> filter(age_lower(age) >= 10) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   age   count #>   <chr> <dbl> #> 1 10-14    20 #> 2 100+      7  ## no action when 'unknown_label' is "silent" age_lower(c("0-4", "young people", "50plus"),           unknown_label = "silent") #>         0-4 youngpeople         50+  #>           0          NA          50

title: Make Mapping Between Age Labels — age_mapping
text: "equals". x equals y. Lower limit x = lower limit y, upper limit x = upper limit y. "contains". x contains y. Lower limit x <= lower limit y, upper limit x >= upper limit y. "contained". x contained y. Lower limit x >= lower limit y, Upper limit x <= upper limit y. "overlaps". x overlaps y. Lower limit y <= lower limit x <  upper limit y, lower limit y <= upper limit x < upper limit y, .

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Cohorts — cohort_lower
code: x <- c("2025-2030", "<2025", "2030-2035") cohort_lower(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>      2025      -Inf      2030  cohort_upper(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>      2030      2025      2035  cohort_width(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>         5       Inf         5  cohort_mid(x) #> 2025-2030     <2025 2030-2035  #>    2027.5    2022.5    2032.5   ## use 'cohort_lower()' to filter on cohort library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(    ~cohort, ~count,               "2025-2030",     20,                   "<2025",      5,               "2030-2035",     11 ) df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   cohort    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2025-2030    20 #> 2 <2025         5 #> 3 2030-2035    11 df |> filter(cohort_lower(cohort) >= 2025) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   cohort    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2025-2030    20 #> 2 2030-2035    11  ## 'label_one' is "lower" (the default) cohort_lower("2025") #> 2025  #> 2025  cohort_upper("2025") #> 2025  #> 2026  cohort_width("2025") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'label_one' is "upper" cohort_lower("2025", label_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2024  cohort_upper("2025", label_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2025  cohort_width("2025", label_one = "upper") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'label_multi' is "include" (the default) cohort_lower("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>      2025  cohort_upper("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>      2030  cohort_width("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>         5   ## 'label_multi' is "exclude" cohort_lower("2025-2030", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>      2025  cohort_upper("2025-2030", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>      2031  cohort_width("2025-2030", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>         6   ## no action when 'unknown_label' is "silent" cohort_lower(c("2000-2005", "long time ago"),              unknown_label = "silent") #>   2000-2005 longtimeago  #>        2000          NA

what: Check or Make Assertions About Periods — period_check
title: Check or Make Assertions About Periods — period_check
text: Collect information period labels (period_check()), throw error period labels conform expectations (period_assert).

title: Check or Make Assertions About Periods — period_check
code: period_check(   x,   no_overlap = NA,   no_gap = NA,   no_total = NA,   no_na = NA,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )  period_assert(   x,   no_overlap = NA,   no_gap = NA,   no_total = NA,   no_na = NA,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )

title: Check or Make Assertions About Periods — period_check
text: x vector period labels. no_overlap periods overlap no_gap periods span entire range lower limit earliest period upper limit latest period no_total "Total" label no_na NA label label_one Whether labels one-year periods based lower upper limit period. Default "lower". label_multi Whether labels multi-year periods include exclude final year period. Default "include". unknown_label Action label interpreted. Choices "error" (default), "warn", "silent".

title: Check or Make Assertions About Periods — period_check
text: period_check() returns list components ok (logical flag) details (data frame). period_assert() returns x invisibly, throws error.

title: Check or Make Assertions About Periods — period_check
code: lab <- period_labels_five(lower_first = 2020,                           lower_last = 2030) #> Error in loadNamespace(x): there is no package called ‘poputils’ lab #> Error: object 'lab' not found  ## get info on everything period_check(x = lab,              no_overlap = TRUE,              no_gap = TRUE,              no_total = TRUE,              no_na = TRUE) #> Error: object 'lab' not found  ## throw error if gaps period_assert(x = lab, no_gap = TRUE) #> Error: object 'lab' not found  lab_gap <- lab[c(1, 3)] #> Error: object 'lab' not found ## throw error if no gaps period_assert(lab_gap, no_gap = FALSE) #> Error: object 'lab_gap' not found

text: Create New Set Period Labels

title: Create a New Set of Period Labels — period_labels
code: period_labels(   breaks,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   include_total = FALSE,   include_na = FALSE )  period_labels_one(   lower_first,   lower_last,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   include_total = FALSE,   include_na = FALSE )  period_labels_five(   lower_first,   lower_last,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   include_total = FALSE,   include_na = FALSE )  period_labels_ten(   lower_first,   lower_last,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   include_total = FALSE,   include_na = FALSE )

title: Create a New Set of Period Labels — period_labels
text: breaks Boundaries periods numeric vector. label_one Whether labels one-year periods based lower upper limit period. Default "lower". label_multi Whether labels multi-year periods include exclude final year period. Default "include". include_total Whether include "Total" category. include_na Whether include NA category. lower_first lower limit first period. lower_last lower limit last period.

title: Create a New Set of Period Labels — period_labels
text: character vector

title: Create a New Set of Period Labels — period_labels
code: ## 5-year periods period_labels_five(lower_first = 2000,                    lower_last = 2010) #> Error in loadNamespace(x): there is no package called ‘poputils’  ## single-year periods period_labels_one(lower_first = 2000,                   lower_last = 2010) #> Error in loadNamespace(x): there is no package called ‘poputils’  ## single-year periods, 'label_one' is "upper" period_labels_one(lower_first = 2000,                   lower_last = 2010,                   label_one = "upper") #> Error in loadNamespace(x): there is no package called ‘poputils’  ## ten-year periods period_labels_ten(lower_first = 2000,                   lower_last = 2010) #> Error in loadNamespace(x): there is no package called ‘poputils’  ## ten-year periods, 'label_multi' is "exclude", period_labels_ten(lower_first = 2000,                   lower_last = 2010,                   label_multi = "exclude") #> Error in loadNamespace(x): there is no package called ‘poputils’  ## include total and NA period_labels_ten(lower_first = 2000,                   lower_last = 2010,                   include_total = TRUE,                   include_na = TRUE) #> Error in loadNamespace(x): there is no package called ‘poputils’

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
code: period_lower(   x,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )  period_mid(   x,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )  period_upper(   x,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )  period_width(   x,   label_one = c("lower", "upper"),   label_multi = c("include", "exclude"),   unknown_label = c("error", "warn", "silent") )

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
text: x vector period labels. label_one Whether labels one-year periods based lower upper limit period. Default "lower". label_multi Whether labels multi-year periods include exclude final year period. Default "include". unknown_label Action label interpreted. Choices "error" (default), "warn", "silent".

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
text: numeric vector length x.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
text: Lower upper limits can used filter periods. See examples.

title: Lower Limits, Upper Limits, Widths, and Midpoints of Periods — period_lower
code: x <- c("2025-2030", "2020-2025", "2030-2035") period_lower(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>      2025      2020      2030  period_upper(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>      2030      2025      2035  period_width(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>         5         5         5  period_mid(x) #> 2025-2030 2020-2025 2030-2035  #>    2027.5    2022.5    2032.5   ## use 'period_lower()' to filter on period library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE) df <- tribble(    ~period, ~count,               "2020-2025",     20,               "2025-2030",      5,               "2030-2035",     11 ) df #> # A tibble: 3 × 2 #>   period    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2020-2025    20 #> 2 2025-2030     5 #> 3 2030-2035    11 df |> filter(period_lower(period) >= 2025) #> # A tibble: 2 × 2 #>   period    count #>   <chr>     <dbl> #> 1 2025-2030     5 #> 2 2030-2035    11  ## 'label_one' is "lower" (the default) period_lower("2025") #> 2025  #> 2025  period_upper("2025") #> 2025  #> 2026  period_width("2025") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'label_one' is "upper" period_lower("2025", label_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2024  period_upper("2025", label_one = "upper") #> 2025  #> 2025  period_width("2025", label_one = "upper") #> 2025  #>    1   ## 'label_multi' is "include" (the default) period_lower("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>      2025  period_upper("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>      2030  period_width("2025-2030") #> 2025-2030  #>         5   ## 'label_multi' is "exclude" period_lower("2025-2030", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>      2025  period_upper("2025-2030", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>      2031  period_width("2025-2030", label_multi = "exclude") #> 2025-2030  #>         6   ## no action when 'unknown_label' is "silent" period_lower(c("2000-2005", "long time ago"),              unknown_label = "silent") #>   2000-2005 longtimeago  #>        2000          NA
